note: Ayer attests that some positivists proposed conclusive verifiability for significance. Mapping the reported position requires fixing the case's scope and proving the formulation itself is covered before applying the self-test. The report is evidence of the position's use, not Ayer's endorsement, and gives no warrant that every meaningful sentence in scope satisfies conclusive verification; it identifies a historically proposed interpretation of the criterion.
